title: Nigerian Universities Directory
sourceName: National Universities Commission — Nigerian University System
dataNotice: This catalogue contains 328 university entries recorded from the NUC Nigerian University System directory as retrieved on 2026-10-16. The source directory is maintained externally and may change; confirm the exact name, current accreditation/status, programme availability, and UTME eligibility using JAMB IBASS and the institution official website. The catalogue is not a guarantee that every institution offers every course.
